mapper.sql: id, task_id, attempt_no, status, exit_code, token_input, token_cached_input, token_output, branch_name, summary, raw_result, schema_valid, changed_files, started_at, finished_at, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task_run WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM task_run WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY attempt_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_run (task_id, attempt_no, status, exit_code, token_input, token_cached_input, token_output, branch_name, summary, raw_result, schema_valid, changed_files, started_at, finished_at, created_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{attemptNo}, #{status}, #{exitCode}, #{tokenInput}, #{tokenCachedInput}, #{tokenOutput}, #{branchName}, #{summary}, #{rawResult}, #{schemaValid}, CAST(#{changedFiles} AS JSON), #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE task_run SET status = #{status}, exit_code = #{exitCode}, token_input = #{tokenInput}, token_cached_input = #{tokenCachedInput}, token_output = #{tokenOutput}, summary = #{summary}, raw_result = #{rawResult}, schema_valid = #{schemaValid}, changed_files = CAST(#{changedFiles} AS JSON), finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
